behavior.distinction_from_packet_88: Packet #88 (0x50e69f0, pointer-mark walk) walks entry chains and STAMPS a mark byte when a node's field equals a mask sentinel: it writes. This window walks one chain and only READS: it compares each node's +0x10 field against zero and returns a byte. A predicate vs a stamping walk, one chain vs entry-selected chains, no store vs a store: the mechanisms differ even though both windows walk chains. No shared primitive is claimed, and no census of chain walks was built.

edges.single_zero_node: Flag clear, one node with +0x10 zero -> 1.

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with endbr64; five branches (four forward, one loop-back), no calls: endbr64; mov (%rdi),%rax; movzbl 0x70(%rax),%edx; test %dl,%dl; jne 0x51a5d98; mov 0x48(%rax),%rax; test %rax,%rax; jne 0x51a5d88; jmp 0x51a5da0; nopw; mov (%rax),%rax; test %rax,%rax; je 0x51a5da0; cmpq $0x0,0x10(%rax); je 0x51a5d80; mov %edx,%eax; ret; nopw; xor %edx,%edx; mov %edx,%eax; ret; nopl; mov $0x1,%edx; mov %edx,%eax; ret. The two nopw/nopl groups are alignment padding inside the body.
behavior.return_rule: eax = 1 exactly when [p+0x70] == 0 (p = [rdi]) and every node on the chain starting at [p+0x48], linked by [node], has [node+0x10] == 0, including the empty chain (head null -> 1). Otherwise eax = 0. All three return paths write a full edx then mov %edx,%eax, so eax is exactly 0 or 1 on every path; no wider-value claim is made beyond that.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.
